# STOC Advisory

> STOC Advisory is a national M&A transaction advisory firm serving middle-market
> businesses and private equity sponsors, with offices in Baltimore, Dallas,
> Minneapolis, Nashville, and Ponte Vedra Beach. Core services include Quality of
> Earnings (QoE) reports, financial due diligence, net working capital analysis,
> corporate development support, growth enablement, and finance & data intelligence.

## Services
- [Transaction Advisory Services](https://www.stocadvisory.com/services/transaction-advisory-services):
  Quality of Earnings reports, net working capital analysis, cash-to-accrual
  conversions, and post-transaction support for buyers, sellers, and lenders
- [Corporate Development Support](https://www.stocadvisory.com/services/corporate-development-support)
- [Growth Enablement Services](https://www.stocadvisory.com/services/growth-enablement-services)
- [Finance & Data Intelligence](https://www.stocadvisory.com/services/finance-data-intelligence)
